item.title: How to Format Percentages with 2 Decimal Places in BigQuery SQL
item.description:
Formatting a result as a percentage with two decimal places in BigQuery SQL can be challenging, especially if you want to avoid converting it to a string. This article will cover different approaches to achieve the desired result while maintaining a clean and readable SQL structure.

Formatting Percentage with Decimal Places: Methods and Examples

Basic Approach: Casting and Concatenation

The primary method involves rounding the division result, casting it as a string, and concatenating the percentage sign.
